name: browsa
description: Cloud browsers for AI agents, and captcha solving for a browser of your own.
long_description: Browsa gives a model a real cloud browser (Phantom): it reads the page as compact text, acts with real input, types saved secrets it never sees, hands over to a person when a check needs one, and replays what it did with no model calls. For agents that drive their own browser, the captcha tools find the captcha in a page's HTML locally and return a solution with the step to apply it in that browser.

tools.name: open
tools.description: Open a cloud browser and go to a URL.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: The page as compact text, one line per element.

tools.name: act
tools.description: One action with real input: click, type, press, scroll and more.

tools.name: read
tools.description: The full content of one container: text, a table or links.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: A JPEG of the viewport, the page or one element.

tools.name: secrets
tools.description: Names of saved secrets; values are never shown.

tools.name: handoff
tools.description: A single-use live link for a person to take over.

tools.name: flow
tools.description: Record steps once, replay them with no model.

tools.name: detect_captcha
tools.description: Optional group captcha_page: find the captchas in a page's HTML, locally.

tools.name: solve_captcha_on_page
tools.description: Optional group captcha_page: solve a token captcha for a browser of your own.

tools.name: captcha_allowance
tools.description: Optional group captcha_page: local captcha limits and spend.

prompts.name: solve_captcha_on_my_page
prompts.description: Detect, solve, apply and verify the captcha on a page in your own browser.
prompts.text: Solve the captcha on ${arguments.url} with detect_captcha and solve_captcha_on_page, apply the answer in my browser and verify.

prompts.name: what_captcha_is_this
prompts.description: Which captcha a page has, and whether Browsa's captcha API takes it.
prompts.text: Tell me which captcha is on ${arguments.url} with detect_captcha. Solve nothing.

prompts.name: pass_check_in_browsa_browser
prompts.description: Open a page in a Browsa browser and get past its check.
prompts.text: Open ${arguments.url} in a Browsa browser; if a check appears, act solve_captcha, then handoff if it stays.

api_key.title: Browsa API key
api_key.description: From https://app.browsa.io/dashboard/keys. detect_captcha works without it.

tools.title: Tool groups
tools.description: Optional. Groups to add to the nine browser tools, e.g. captcha_page or tasks,robots. captcha_page,-core lists only the captcha tools for your own browser.

captcha_max_credits.title: Captcha spend cap (credits)
captcha_max_credits.description: Optional. The most credits one session may spend on captcha solves, e.g. 5.
